subject: design/coverage-on-read
statement: the requirements-coverage view is **computed on read, committed nowhere.** A new `docgate coverage` verb joins the universe against live designs' `serves` from committed inputs and prints it; `gen-index`/`index.*` carry only design-plane data (liveness, `serves_inverse`). Adding or amending a ledger therefore never touches `docs/tech-design/`; `index.*` regenerates only when *designs* change.
